# Logos

The visual mark of PLUS, shown with or without the wordmark.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/Logos.mdx`

## Overview

Use the logo to mark PLUS in the tutor and student apps: the sidebar and navbar header, sign-in, email headers and the loading screen. Never use it as decoration. Its colors are brand artwork rather than theme tokens, so it looks the same on every surface.

```jsx
import { Logo } from '@/components';
```

See Logo for props and code.

## One logo, two parts

The logo has two parts: the logomark and the wordmark. Together they form the lockup. In product, always render the `Logo` component rather than redrawing or exporting the mark by hand.

## Logomark shape and size

The logomark ships in fixed heights: 16, 20, 24, 32, 48, 64 and 96. At 24 and below it uses a heavier small-size drawing so the plus stays open. Pick a step; never scale an instance by hand.

## Construction

The logomark is drawn on a 12 by 12 unit square (1 unit = 8 of the 96 drawing coordinates). Two circles of 6 and 4.5 units share its center, two 2-unit corner circles sit at the top right and bottom left, and the 3-unit plus is centered 8.5 units from the left and 3.5 from the top. Use the `Logo` component; the drawing explains the shape and is not a template to redraw from.

## Color options

Choose the color option for the ground the logo sits on.

| Color option | Ground | When to use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Colored | Light and dark surfaces | Default. Brand artwork on a light ground; in dark mode each glow steps one lighter. |
| Colored dark | Dark surfaces | Stronger glows, fixed across color modes. |
| Filled | Light grounds | Solid teal tile with a white plus and dark wordmark, where the glow cannot sit. |
| Dark | Dark grounds | Solid deep teal tile with a white plus and light wordmark. |
| Outlined | Light grounds | Dark outline mark, where a solid block competes with content. |
| Outlined reversed | Photos or dark grounds | Light outline mark, where a solid block hides or competes with an image. |

## Logo clearance

Keep clear space around the logo, measured from the logomark's edge. Align the logo to neighbors by the logomark's edge and center it with adjacent text.

| Rule | Value | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Clear space | Half the logomark’s height | On every side, measured from the edge of the logomark, not the edge of the Logo frame. |
| Minimum size | 24 (lockup) · 16 (logomark) | Below 24, use the logomark alone. |

## Do and don't

### Use approved colors

Use the color options as drawn, on the ground each belongs on.

Do: The colored logomark on a light ground.
Don't: An unapproved color combination.

### Keep the logomark's shape and proportions

Pick a size step. Do not stretch, crop or rotate the logomark.

Do: A size step, wordmark included.
Don't: A stretched logomark.

### Give the logomark breathing room

Do not add unnecessary containers around the logomark. Never rebuild it from shapes or type; use the Logo component.

Do: The logomark on its own, with space around it.
Don't: The logomark nested in an extra container.

### Keep the artwork clean

Do not add effects to the logo or edit the artwork. Use the outlined option on photos and busy grounds, and keep to one Logo per view: partner and tool logos go in a Tile, never in the Logo set.

Do: The logomark as drawn.
Don't: A drop shadow added to the logomark.

## Accessibility

Write the name in the alt text for the logo in digital experiences.

| Case | Alt text |
| --- | --- |
| Logo is the only thing naming PLUS (sign-in screen) | PLUS |
| Logo sits beside a visible PLUS title | Empty. It is decorative; hide it from assistive technology. |
| Logo links home | PLUS home (names where it goes). Give it keyboard focus and the focus ring. |

- Choose the color option by ground so the logomark keeps its contrast.
